items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I think there was a guy, I think Chris Keller was waking up there... And I remember Chris Keller

ctx.x: But the whole second floor was one big dance hall?

One just like a, yeah, it run the whole width of the place. Well like I say, going back to there, now they had other places running in that vicinity, the Astoria was running. Then they had another place on Grabber Street, between Ramport and Drys, upstairs, was running. In other words, you had four places running in that vicinity. You had the Roof Court and the Pelican, the Astoria, and this place on Grabber Street. And that's what I remember, when I came back at that time, I think there was a guy, I think Chris…
